title: Fables for the Frivolous - The Persevering Tortoise and the Pretentious Hare
summary: Fables for the Frivolous by . One of the earliest works by the American parodist, Guy Wetmore Carryl, these fables are adapted from Jean de La Fontaine’s original writings. The fables are written in verse, and are light-hearted re-tellings of fables from two centuries before, each ending with a moral and a pun.
